$comment: Generated by scripts/influence/build-field-shelf.mjs from OpenAlex (self-citations removed). Do not edit by hand. squares: [OpenAlex id number (prefix 'W'), x, y (top-left px in the field box), citedBy (OpenAlex cited_by_count of the citing work), publication year, paperIdxs (indexes into papers)]. Field colour/position = citation impact (log bins); topic distance is footnote-only.

meta.encodingText: Each square is one citing work. Colour = that work's own OpenAlex cited_by_count on a log-ish sequential ember–ink ramp; nearer the centre = more cited. Direction means nothing. The All / Lead chip filters squares and shelf only.
meta.homeTopicsRuleText: Home topics = the OpenAlex topics (all listed topics plus the assigned one) on Ken's lead papers, computed once. Distance d is still computed for optional footnotes and show-me tooling, but does not colour or place the field (Ken, 2026-10-11).
